title: Harmony Hall at Elliston Place
description:
Welcome to the Harmony Hall Suite, Loft 202 — a nod to the harmonies of classic country, rock, and soul music that shaped Music City. Vibe is warm, vintage, and melodious — perfect for group stays with heart and history — your all-access pass to Nashville’s legendary music scene! Just 1 mile from the neon lights of Broadway and steps from Vanderbilt, this 3-bedroom, 3-bath apartment hits all the right notes with a one-of-a-kind décor inspired by Country Western royalty.  Highlights: 
Gold & Plat

The space
Loft 202, Harmony Hall, is located right above the Elliston Place Soda Shop in the Rock Block neighborhood and within walking distance to Ascension St. Thomas and Vanderbilt University and a mile from Broadway, the Ryman, Bridgestone Arena, Music Row and all things downtown Nashville.  You will feel like a star in this immersive, music-themed space where every detail is a tribute to the legends of the Grand Ole Opry. Whether you’re headed to Nashville for good old country fun, business or an extended stay, this is the place for you.

Guest access
Rock Block Lofts have their own private entrance at the back of the Soda Shop Restaurant building. Go up a short staircase and ent through the glass doors. Loft 202 is down the hallway to your right.
